question:
A pair of dice is thrown 5 times. Find the probability that a sum of 7 appears at least once. 
(b) Find the expected number of times a sum of 7 will appear.
(c) If it appears exactly 2 times, what is the probability the sum is 7 in the first two throws?
explanation:
Probability of sum 7 in one throw:
There are 6 ways: (1,6),(2,5),(3,4),(4,3),(5,2),(6,1); total 36 outcomes, probability = 6/36 = 1/6.

(a) Probability at least once: $1 - P(\text{never in 5})$
$P(\text{not 7})=5/6$ each time
$P(\text{never})=(5/6)^5$
$P(\text{at least once})=1-(5/6)^5$
$(5/6)^5 = 3125/7776$
So $=1-3125/7776=4651/7776$

(b) Expected number = $5\times1/6=5/6$

(c) Probability sum = 7 in first two, not in next three:
That is: success, success, fail, fail, fail
$=(1/6)^2\times(5/6)^3=1/36\times125/216=125/7776$

Final answers:
(a)$4651/7776$
(b)$5/6$
(c)$125/7776$
